evaluation_metadata.evaluation_standard: Institutional Legal Drafting & Indian Contract Act 1872 DevOps Standard

review_comments: Contract meets statutory requirements under Indian Contract Act 1872

sections_audit.section_name: SCOPE OF COMMERCIAL ENGAGEMENT / DELIVERABLES / SLAs

section_27_restraint_of_trade.statutory_basis: Section 27, Indian Contract Act 1872; Percept D'Mark v. Zaheer Khan (2006)
section_27_restraint_of_trade.finding: Void post-termination blanket non-compete avoided; covenants confined to employee non-solicitation (2 years) and trade secret non-disclosure.

section_74_liquidated_damages.statutory_basis: Section 74, Indian Contract Act 1872; Kailash Nath Associates v. DDA (2015)
section_74_liquidated_damages.finding: Clause 5.4.3 labels 1.5% monthly compounding late fee as a 'Late Payment Penalty' rather than a genuine pre-estimate of loss or reasonable compensation cap.

perkins_eastman_arbitration_neutrality.statutory_basis: Section 12(5) ACA 1996; Perkins Eastman Architects DPC v. HSCC (India) Ltd. (2020)
perkins_eastman_arbitration_neutrality.finding: Arbitrator appointed by mutual consent with neutral institutional fallback (ICC Secretary-General / Bangalore City Civil Court).

section_28_restraint_of_legal_proceeding.statutory_basis: Section 28, Indian Contract Act 1872; Hakam Singh v. Gammon (India) Ltd.
section_28_restraint_of_legal_proceeding.finding: Exclusive jurisdiction vested in competent Courts of Bengaluru where parties execute obligations.
